summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K to disclose routine updates to its at-the-market offering program and bitcoin holdings. The ATM update covers sales from May 26-31, 2026, showing no preferred stock sales and 801,994 shares of Class A common stock sold for net proceeds of $128.3 million. The company also sold 32 bitcoins for an aggregate sale price of $2.5 million. Remaining capacities for each security are listed. There is no M&A, activist, tender, restructuring, or other special situation; this is a standard periodic disclosure of ongoing capital markets activity.
